intent: Maintaining the current speed and lane position while being alert to potential hazards from traffic density and construction work.
Maintaining speed allows for better observation of the evolving situation, while keeping a safe distance from other vehicles and being prepared for potential sudden maneuvers.
To maintain safety by reducing speed and creating a safer distance from other vehicles while navigating cautiously around the collision scene.
To ensure safety and avoid potential collisions due to the critical hazard of a blocked lane and immediate proximity of other vehicles.
Maintaining speed allows for better reaction time to any unexpected situations and minimizes the risk of further collisions.
To minimize the risk of collision with other vehicles or debris, given the high severity of the situation and unsafe lane changes.
To minimize the risk of collision with potential debris or other vehicles while maintaining a safe distance.
